# Demo source project

These files hold the API answers that a Redmine 4 source gives the reader account
Mirror uses. That source runs Mirror source, Redmine Tags and Scrum. The answers come
from `generate.rb`, which describes the whole project. They follow the format of a real
Redmine 4.0 source and include its refusals:

- 403 on issue categories and custom fields;
- the users' details are not shared.

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `generate.rb` | The project, case by case; writes the other files |
| `CASES.md` | Every case, what Mirror must do with it and the test that checks it |
| `answers.json` | Request (path and sorted parameters) → `body`, or the `error` the source answers |
| `downloads.json` | Download path → `file`, or `size` only for files over 100 KB |
| `files/` | Small real files: PNG, JPEG, GIF, SVG, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ZIP, JSON, CSV, text |
| `meta.json` | Source project ID |

## The project

*Demo shop* uses Redmine's default references plus two values to map in each list:

| List | Values |
| --- | --- |
| Trackers | Bug, Feature, Support, then Task and Epic |
| Statuses | New, In Progress, Resolved, Feedback, Closed, Rejected, then In review and On hold |
| Priorities | Low, Normal, High, Urgent, Immediate |
| Activities | Design, Development, then Testing and Project management |
| Document categories | User documentation, Technical documentation, then Meeting minutes and Specifications |
| Roles | Manager, Developer, Reporter, then Mirror reader and Client |

The project has 6 members:

- John Doe, the owner;
- Alice Client;
- Bob Former, who left (locked account);
- Tom Developer;
- Paula Pilot;
- Mirror Reader.

The issues have two custom fields, *Severity* and *Customer reference*.

Each of the 53 issues covers one case, named in its subject. The description and notes
tell its short story, or use lorem ipsum where only the volume matters.

| Theme | Cases |
| --- | --- |
| `[Text]` | Textile, Markdown in a Textile project, plain text, empty, 255-character subject with HTML, accents, emoji, 60 KB, references, inline and sized images, image in a note |
| `[Files]` | Every file type, 5 MB file, names with spaces and accents, attachment removed in the history, same name twice |
| `[State]` | Private, closed or locked version, version shared by another project, rejected, reopened, moved, category of another project, user who left, empty fields, dates and estimate, custom fields, extra tracker, status and priority |
| `[History]` | Every field changed, private notes, 100 notes, note by a user who left, quote and code |
| `[Tree]` | Three levels, subtask older than its parent, parent changed in the history |
| `[Links]` | Every relation type with a delay, copy, relation to a project that is not mirrored |
| `[Watch]` | Four watchers, one of whom left |
| `[Time]` | Several users and activities, user who left, 120 entries over two pages |
| `[Agile]` | Tags with accents and capitals, sprint and story points, sprint of another project, sprint changed in the history |

The project also has:

- 12 wiki pages, in three levels of hierarchy and with their history. Their titles
  include a number, an accent and an apostrophe; one page is long and one is written in
  Markdown.
- 5 documents, 4 news with comments, and 4 files, on the project or on its versions.
- 11 saved queries. 4 of them have no local equivalent: a Scrum filter, a tag filter, a
  named subproject and an agile board.
- 5 sprints, including a duplicate name and the backlog.

## Tests

`test/mirror_demo_source.rb` serves these answers. A request with no answer gets a 404
and is listed in `unrecorded`; the tests check that this list stays empty. Files
declared by size get generated bytes.

- `test/mirror_demo_test.rb` runs without Redmine. It covers the reference catalog, the
  refusals, the text formats, and the issue and time entry writes.
- `test/unit/mirror_demo_modules_test.rb` imports the project with every module that
  writes locally, without error, then checks that a second pass changes nothing.

To add a case, edit `generate.rb`, run `ruby test/fixtures/mirror_demo/generate.rb`,
update the counts the tests expect, and commit the generated files with it.
